items.title: Closing Bell LIVE: Smallcaps Crash 2.6%, Midcaps Bleed, VIX Jumps | Market Ends the Week in the Red
items.description: The week ends the way it went, with Dalal Street unable to catch a break. Nifty slipped more than half a percent, but the real pain was in the broader market, where the Smallcap index sank 2.6% and the Midcap index lost nearly 2.5% in heavy selling into the close. The volatility index jumped 6%, a sign of how jittery the market is heading into the weekend. Among sectors, Realty and Metal took the biggest beating, while Nifty IT stayed close to flat and resisted the selling. Tata Steel and Tata Motors PV were among the top Nifty losers, and Swiggy crashed after its results. Watch our live Closing Bell for the full market wrap, the stocks that moved the most and what to expect when trading resumes next week.
